From the grill and the kitchen

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A family table on the road to Cape Greco

Nameless is a family-owned bar and restaurant at Protaras to Cape Greco Avenue 360, a little away from the strip. The menu is Cypriot: cold and hot meze, the BBQ grill with souvlaki, seftalia and the jumbo pork chop, and homemade specials such as lamb shank kleftiko, stifado and mom’s mousaka.

Open seven days a week, from lunchtime until 11 pm, Sunday until 10 pm. Tuesday from 2 pm and Wednesday from 5:30 pm.
